description:
Set a member's monthly cap on the pool (null removes it). A run started near the cap
    holds only what is left, so the cap is never passed mid-run (403 team_cap_reached below a
    run's minimum or a tool's price). Owner only. Needs admin. Free. Same as PATCH
    /v1/team/members/{member_id}.

monthly_cap.description: 1 to 1,000,000 credits a UTC month, or null for no cap
monthly_cap.title: Monthly Cap

name: set_team_member_cap
